properties.evidence: Its unthreaded_cluster message (heal.rs) lists the node kinds not walked and "CONTAINS is not a traceability edge", but says nothing of the inference and relation edges (CAUSES, CONTRADICTS, EVOLVES_INTO, DEPENDS_ON between ideas...). nodes.rs structural_rule excludes those by design. The skills teach agents to draw exactly those, so a drawn CAUSES reads as a thread and is not one.
